newsitem.title: USA: Penn Traffic Dec sales down 8.5 pct-sources.
newsitem.headline: Penn Traffic Dec sales down 8.5 pct-sources.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co same store sales for the month of December fell 8.5 percent, according to market sources.
The company released the sales results to Wall Street analysts earlier this week, they said. Penn Traffic would not immediately confirm or deny the figure.
Rumors of the drop triggered a sell-off in the company's high yield bonds on Thursday and Friday, traders said.
Penn Traffic's 9.625 percent bonds due 2005 fell four points on Thursday and another four points on Friday, traders said. They were quoted at a 49 bid in Friday's trading session, they added.
